#### Clase `UnreliableObjectReceiveStream` (Línea 17)
- **Docstring:** _An interface for receiving objects.

This interface makes no guarantees that the received messages arrive in the order in
which they were sent, or that no messages are missed.

Asynchronously iterating over objects of this type will yield objects matching the
given type parameter._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __aiter__(self)` (Línea 30): Sin docstring.
  - `def __anext__(self)` (Línea 33): Sin docstring.
  - `def receive(self)` (Línea 40): Receive the next item.

:raises ~anyio.ClosedResourceError: if the receive stream has been explicitly
    closed
:raises ~anyio.EndOfStream: if this stream has been closed from the other end
:raises ~anyio.BrokenResourceError: if this stream has been rendered unusable
    due to external causes

#### Clase `UnreliableObjectSendStream` (Línea 52)
- **Docstring:** _An interface for sending objects.

This interface makes no guarantees that the messages sent will reach the
recipient(s) in the same order in which they were sent, or at all._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def send(self, item)` (Línea 63): Send an item to the peer(s).

:param item: the item to send
:raises ~anyio.ClosedResourceError: if the send stream has been explicitly
    closed
:raises ~anyio.BrokenResourceError: if this stream has been rendered unusable
    due to external causes

#### Clase `UnreliableObjectStream` (Línea 75)
- **Docstring:** _A bidirectional message stream which does not guarantee the order or reliability of
message delivery._

#### Clase `ObjectReceiveStream` (Línea 84)
- **Docstring:** _A receive message stream which guarantees that messages are received in the same
order in which they were sent, and that no messages are missed._

#### Clase `ObjectSendStream` (Línea 91)
- **Docstring:** _A send message stream which guarantees that messages are delivered in the same order
in which they were sent, without missing any messages in the middle._

#### Clase `ObjectStream` (Línea 98)
- **Docstring:** _A bidirectional message stream which guarantees the order and reliability of message
delivery._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def send_eof(self)` (Línea 109): Send an end-of-file indication to the peer.

You should not try to send any further data to this stream after calling this
method. This method is idempotent (does nothing on successive calls).

#### Clase `ByteReceiveStream` (Línea 118)
- **Docstring:** _An interface for receiving bytes from a single peer.

Iterating this byte stream will yield a byte string of arbitrary length, but no more
than 65536 bytes._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __aiter__(self)` (Línea 126): Sin docstring.
  - `def __anext__(self)` (Línea 129): Sin docstring.
  - `def receive(self, max_bytes)` (Línea 136): Receive at most ``max_bytes`` bytes from the peer.

.. note:: Implementers of this interface should not return an empty
    :class:`bytes` object, and users should ignore them.

:param max_bytes: maximum number of bytes to receive
:return: the received bytes
:raises ~anyio.EndOfStream: if this stream has been closed from the other end
